top_reviews.review_title: Works well for Tesla Wall Connector
top_reviews.review_text:
I clipped the ends off and used it fine with a Tesla Wall Connector. Be sure to twist the strands well before putting them in the terminals - they're finer than the kind of wire you'd hardwire with, so they'll tend to fan out under the screw and slip out to the sides. Otherwise, follow Tesla's instructions, including looping the cable and securing it with a zip tie. Be sure to use a 3/4 cable gland for strain relief and SET YOUR CHARGER TO 40 AMPS MAX! This cable is rated 50 amps, but for continuous loads like charging a car, code requires an 80% derate for safety due to heat build up... the default setting on Tesla chargers is 48 amps. Adding a 14-50 whip to a hardwired charger isn't code compliant anyway, but you'd be a fool not to abide by the 80% rule.

top_reviews.review_title: Perfect fit for an EV recharge project
top_reviews.review_text:
I was looking to convert a hardwired Juicebox EV charger to a plug-in charger with a NEMA 14-50 plug.  This product fit my needs perfectly.  The two hot conductors are 6 awg and capable of carrying 50 amps.  The plug is sturdy and fits easily into the 14-50 receptacle.  My EV charger reconfiguration project was a success.

top_reviews.review_text:

top_reviews.review_title: Nice quality, wish the conductor ends were a little smaller.
top_reviews.review_text:
Bought this pigtail for my blink hq100 charger. Worked fine, but the length of wire after the cladding was an inch too long and I had to do some bending to make it all fit. Also the ends are a little too wide, so I had to crimp them down a little. Sorta pain. Also you’ll want to pick up a 1” romex connector since a spare doesn’t come with this it the blink charging station. You’ll also find that the charger doesn’t have separate ground and neutral leads, so you’ll have to tie them together since this is 4-wire. Maybe rethink what plug and receptacle you want if you only really need 3 wire!

top_reviews.review_title: Works well, could stand a little improvement
top_reviews.review_text:
Worked well to install on my new range, and the 4' length was perfect - not too much slack to bind up under the appliance.  My one suggestion would be to strip a bit more of the black outer insulation off since for ranges with 4 terminals you need a bit more flex to bend the 4 conductors (especially the ground) to fit the 3 main terminals and the chassis ground.
